title: a screen-based device
meaning_vi: thiết bị có màn hình

examples.en: With nothing more than a screen-based device, anyone can access an enormous range of entertainment content today.

title: diverse streaming platforms
meaning_vi: các nền tảng phát trực tuyến đa dạng

examples.en: The emergence of diverse streaming platforms has catalysed widespread adoption of online entertainment.

title: shifting consumer habits
meaning_vi: sự thay đổi thói quen của người tiêu dùng

examples.en: Shifting consumer habits have pushed the entertainment industry to invest heavily in streaming services.

title: technological advances
meaning_vi: những tiến bộ công nghệ

examples.en: Technological advances have made it possible for fans anywhere in the world to watch a concert live from their phones.

title: virtual concert premieres
meaning_vi: các buổi ra mắt hòa nhạc trực tuyến

examples.en: Virtual concert premieres now generate as much online buzz as traditional album launches once did.

title: benign form of relaxation
meaning_vi: hình thức thư giãn vô hại

examples.en: Many parents view video games as a benign form of relaxation rather than a genuine cause for concern.

title: simulation games
meaning_vi: trò chơi mô phỏng

examples.en: Simulation games offer children the opportunity to freely design their own virtual world, which fosters their creativity.

title: strategic games
meaning_vi: trò chơi chiến thuật

examples.en: Strategic games require players to plan several moves ahead, which can sharpen logical thinking.

title: cognitive benefits
meaning_vi: lợi ích về nhận thức

examples.en: Puzzle-based video games are often praised for their cognitive benefits, such as improved memory.

title: come at a steep cost
meaning_vi: phải trả giá đắt, đi kèm cái giá lớn

examples.en: The cognitive benefits of gaming often come at a steep cost to children's physical health.

title: encouragement of aggressive behaviour
meaning_vi: sự cổ xúy hành vi hung hăng

examples.en: One major criticism of violent video games is their encouragement of aggressive behaviour among young players.

title: frequent consumption of simulated violence
meaning_vi: việc tiếp xúc thường xuyên với bạo lực mô phỏng

examples.en: Frequent consumption of simulated violence in video games has been linked to increased aggression in some studies.

title: immersive and addictive nature of modern games
term: immersive and addictive nature of modern games
pronunciation: /ɪˈmɜːsɪv ənd əˈdɪktɪv ˈneɪtʃər əv ˈmɒdən ɡeɪmz/
meaning_vi: bản chất hấp dẫn và gây nghiện của các trò chơi hiện đại

examples.en: The immersive and addictive nature of modern games makes it difficult for children to set their own limits.

title: lead to over-reliance or addiction
meaning_vi: dẫn đến sự lệ thuộc quá mức hoặc nghiện

examples.en: Unrestricted access to video games can lead to over-reliance or addiction among vulnerable children.

title: poor posture
meaning_vi: tư thế ngồi/đứng không tốt

examples.en: Hours spent hunched over a games console can lead to poor posture and long-term back problems.

title: prolonged exposure to screens
meaning_vi: việc tiếp xúc kéo dài với màn hình

examples.en: Prolonged exposure to screens has been linked to eye strain and disrupted sleep patterns in children.

title: reduced attention spans
meaning_vi: khả năng tập trung bị giảm sút

examples.en: Critics argue that fast-paced digital entertainment is responsible for reduced attention spans among young people.

title: triggers heightened aggressive thoughts
meaning_vi: kích hoạt những suy nghĩ hung hăng gia tăng

examples.en: Playing violent video games for extended periods triggers heightened aggressive thoughts in certain players.

title: attention span
meaning_vi: khoảng thời gian tập trung chú ý

examples.en: Frequent exposure to rapidly changing video content may shorten children's attention span over time.

title: distinguish fantasy from reality
meaning_vi: phân biệt giữa tưởng tượng và thực tế

examples.en: Young children often struggle to distinguish fantasy from reality when watching violent films.

title: impair their ability
meaning_vi: làm suy giảm khả năng của ai đó

examples.en: Spending excessive time on screens can impair their ability to concentrate on tasks that require sustained attention.

title: instill a sense of discipline
meaning_vi: hình thành ý thức kỷ luật

examples.en: Structured extracurricular programs can instill a sense of discipline that benefits children throughout their lives.

title: socializing with peers
meaning_vi: giao tiếp, kết bạn với bạn bè cùng trang lứa

examples.en: Children who spend hours in front of a screen have less time for socializing with peers.

title: weaker impulse control
meaning_vi: khả năng kiểm soát xung động yếu hơn

examples.en: Children generally have weaker impulse control than adults, making them more vulnerable to violent media content.

title: compete against opponents or overcome challenges
term: compete against opponents or overcome challenges
meaning_vi: cạnh tranh với đối thủ hoặc vượt qua thử thách

examples.en: Many video games require players to compete against opponents or overcome challenges, which builds resilience.

title: enabling the growth of problem solving skills
term: enabling the growth of problem solving skills
pronunciation: /ɪˈneɪblɪŋ ðə ɡrəʊθ əv ˈprɒbləm ˈsɒlvɪŋ skɪlz/
meaning_vi: tạo điều kiện phát triển kỹ năng giải quyết vấn đề

examples.en: Puzzle-based video games are effective in enabling the growth of problem solving skills among young players.

title: fosters their creativity
meaning_vi: nuôi dưỡng sự sáng tạo của trẻ

examples.en: Building elaborate structures in sandbox games fosters children's creativity in ways traditional toys sometimes cannot.

title: sophisticated hand-eye coordination
meaning_vi: khả năng phối hợp tay-mắt tinh vi

examples.en: Fast-paced action games can help players develop sophisticated hand-eye coordination over time.

title: stimulating specific cognitive abilities
meaning_vi: kích thích các khả năng nhận thức cụ thể

examples.en: While video games are effective at stimulating specific cognitive abilities, their addictive nature often negates these benefits.

title: strategic planning
meaning_vi: lập kế hoạch chiến lược

examples.en: Complex video games often require strategic planning, which can sharpen players' problem-solving abilities.

title: knowledge acquisition
meaning_vi: sự tiếp thu kiến thức

examples.en: Educational television programmes can support knowledge acquisition among children when used in moderation.

title: a form of entertainment
meaning_vi: một hình thức giải trí

examples.en: For many people, music is primarily a form of entertainment enjoyed during leisure time rather than a tool for social change.

title: a live performance in person
meaning_vi: một buổi biểu diễn trực tiếp tham dự tận nơi

examples.en: Many people save up money specifically to experience a live performance in person at least once a year.

title: a performance's appeal
meaning_vi: sức hấp dẫn của một buổi biểu diễn

examples.en: The interaction between performer and crowd is a vital factor in a performance's appeal that a screen cannot fully capture.

title: adept
meaning_vi: thành thạo, khéo léo

examples.en: Musicians who are adept at playing traditional instruments often spend a lifetime refining their skills.

title: attending a live performance
meaning_vi: việc tham dự một buổi biểu diễn trực tiếp

examples.en: Attending a live performance gives audiences a sense of connection with artists that television broadcasts simply cannot replicate.

title: authenticity
meaning_vi: tính chân thực, tính xác thực

examples.en: The authenticity of a live show is what draws millions of fans to concerts every year despite the high ticket prices.

title: be generically classed
meaning_vi: được xếp loại chung

examples.en: Most of the functions of music can be generically classed as tools for relaxation or emotional expression.

title: catalysts
meaning_vi: chất xúc tác, yếu tố thúc đẩy

examples.en: Iconic songs have often served as catalysts for major cultural and political movements around the world.

title: caters
meaning_vi: đáp ứng, phục vụ (nhu cầu)

examples.en: The modern music industry caters to a wide range of tastes, from classical compositions to electronic beats.

title: communal energy
meaning_vi: năng lượng tập thể, cảm giác cộng đồng

examples.en: The communal energy of thousands of fans singing together is one reason live shows remain irreplaceable.

title: consume music
meaning_vi: thưởng thức/nghe nhạc (tiêu thụ âm nhạc)

examples.en: Thanks to streaming platforms, people can consume music anywhere and at any time of day.

title: convenience of experiencing plays
meaning_vi: sự tiện lợi khi thưởng thức các vở kịch

examples.en: Streaming services have increased the convenience of experiencing plays without having to leave the house.

title: crowd effect
meaning_vi: hiệu ứng đám đông

examples.en: Thanks to the crowd effect, concertgoers often feel more excitement than they would watching the same performance alone at home.

title: delirium
meaning_vi: sự cuồng nhiệt, phấn khích tột độ

examples.en: The crowd was thrown into delirium the moment their favourite band stepped onto the stage.

title: detractors
meaning_vi: những người phản đối, chỉ trích

examples.en: Detractors of this view insist that music serves no purpose beyond providing simple entertainment.

title: dynamic
meaning_vi: sôi động, năng động

examples.en: Live bands create a dynamic atmosphere in venues such as bars and clubs, which recorded music alone cannot replicate.

title: elicits
meaning_vi: khơi gợi, gợi lên (phản ứng, ý kiến)

examples.en: The question of whether music serves a deeper purpose elicits contrasting opinions among scholars and the public alike.

title: engagement records
meaning_vi: kỷ lục về mức độ tương tác

examples.en: The livestreamed festival broke several engagement records, with millions of comments posted during a single performance.

title: feel the atmosphere of the show
term: feel the atmosphere of the show
meaning_vi: cảm nhận được bầu không khí của buổi biểu diễn

examples.en: Only by attending in person can audiences truly feel the atmosphere of the show, from the lighting to the crowd's energy.

title: frequent sell-out events
meaning_vi: các sự kiện thường xuyên bán hết vé

examples.en: Popular bands continue to hold frequent sell-out events, proving that audiences still crave the experience of live music.

title: humanly engineered creative process
meaning_vi: quá trình sáng tạo do con người tạo ra

examples.en: Composing a song is a humanly engineered creative process that reflects the emotions and experiences of the artist.

title: in consummate accord with
meaning_vi: hoàn toàn đồng ý với

examples.en: I am in consummate accord with the view that classical musicians deserve greater recognition for their years of training.

title: international viewership
meaning_vi: lượng người xem quốc tế

examples.en: The singer's virtual concert attracted unprecedented international viewership, far exceeding the capacity of any physical venue.

title: live performances
meaning_vi: buổi biểu diễn trực tiếp

examples.en: The streaming of live performances online has witnessed a remarkable surge in popularity over the past decade.

title: mastering instruments
meaning_vi: việc thành thạo các loại nhạc cụ

examples.en: Mastering instruments such as the violin or piano often requires more than a decade of rigorous practice.

title: masterpieces
meaning_vi: kiệt tác

examples.en: Some classical compositions are regarded as timeless masterpieces that continue to inspire musicians today.

title: multifaceted
meaning_vi: đa diện, nhiều khía cạnh

examples.en: Music plays a multifaceted role in society, influencing everything from personal emotions to collective identity.

title: opine
meaning_vi: phát biểu ý kiến, cho rằng

examples.en: Some critics opine that pop stars should not earn more than classically trained musicians who dedicate years to their craft.

title: performers' mistakes
meaning_vi: những sai sót của người biểu diễn

examples.en: Some spectators argue that performers' mistakes during a live show add a sense of authenticity that polished recordings lack.

title: primary function
meaning_vi: chức năng chính

examples.en: Critics maintain that the primary function of popular music is simply to entertain listeners rather than to educate them.

title: providing insights into
meaning_vi: cung cấp cái nhìn sâu sắc về

examples.en: Folk songs are valuable for providing insights into the daily struggles and traditions of past generations.

title: real human performers
meaning_vi: những nghệ sĩ biểu diễn bằng con người thật

examples.en: Audiences often find greater satisfaction in watching real human performers rather than digitally enhanced recordings.

title: remarkable surge
meaning_vi: sự gia tăng đáng kể

examples.en: There has been a remarkable surge in demand for virtual concert tickets since the pandemic began.

title: resort to
meaning_vi: tìm đến, dùng đến (biện pháp nào đó)

examples.en: Many employees resort to music during their commute as a way of coping with the pressures of daily life.

title: selling out within minutes
meaning_vi: bán hết vé chỉ trong vài phút

examples.en: Tickets for the world tour ended up selling out within minutes, reflecting the band's enduring popularity.

title: spontaneous reactions
meaning_vi: những phản ứng tự nhiên, bộc phát

examples.en: The spontaneous reactions of a live crowd create an unpredictable energy that pre-recorded shows fail to convey.

title: tangible atmosphere
meaning_vi: bầu không khí có thể cảm nhận rõ ràng

examples.en: Attending a concert in person offers a tangible atmosphere that no screen can fully replicate.

title: the necessity of experiencing a live performance
term: the necessity of experiencing a live performance
pronunciation: /ðə nɪˈsesəti əv ɪkˈspɪəriənsɪŋ ə laɪv pəˈfɔːməns/
meaning_vi: sự cần thiết của việc trải nghiệm một buổi biểu diễn trực tiếp

examples.en: Some purists insist on the necessity of experiencing a live performance rather than watching a broadcast at home.

title: the show's venue
meaning_vi: địa điểm tổ chức buổi biểu diễn

examples.en: Fans who travel to the show's venue often report a stronger emotional connection with the performers than online viewers do.

title: thorough understanding
meaning_vi: sự am hiểu sâu sắc

examples.en: Composing classical pieces demands a thorough understanding of music theory that takes years to acquire.

title: ticket release
meaning_vi: đợt phát hành vé

examples.en: Fans camped outside the box office overnight ahead of the official ticket release.

title: unique and genuine
meaning_vi: độc đáo và chân thực

examples.en: Every live concert is unique and genuine, since no two performances are ever exactly the same.

title: use
meaning_vi: công dụng, mục đích sử dụng

examples.en: Music serves a variety of uses, from providing entertainment to helping people manage stress after a long day at work.

title: Curators
meaning_vi: người phụ trách quản lý và trưng bày hiện vật (bảo tàng, triển lãm)

examples.en: Curators spend years researching artefacts to ensure that museum displays are both accurate and engaging.

title: exhibits
meaning_vi: hiện vật, vật trưng bày

examples.en: Museums arrange their exhibits in a way that helps visitors understand historical events in context.

title: irreplaceable
meaning_vi: không thể thay thế được

examples.en: The hands-on experience of examining ancient artefacts in person is irreplaceable and cannot be matched by a website.

title: a more polished but significantly less authentic performance
term: a more polished but significantly less authentic performance
pronunciation: /ə mɔːr ˈpɒlɪʃt bʌt sɪɡˈnɪfɪkəntli les ɔːˈθentɪk pəˈfɔːməns/
meaning_vi: một màn trình diễn hoàn hảo hơn nhưng kém chân thực hơn nhiều

examples.en: Televised broadcasts often deliver a more polished but significantly less authentic performance than what audiences experience in person.

title: brain functioning
meaning_vi: chức năng hoạt động của não bộ

examples.en: Some scientists claim that classical music can enhance brain functioning in young children.

title: enjoyment
meaning_vi: sự vui thích, niềm vui

examples.en: Listening to music provides enjoyment that helps people relax after a stressful day at work.

title: grasp the full picture
meaning_vi: nắm bắt toàn bộ bức tranh, hiểu rõ toàn cảnh

examples.en: Without visiting a museum in person, visitors may fail to grasp the full picture of a nation's cultural heritage.

title: question
meaning_vi: đặt nghi vấn, hoài nghi

examples.en: Some people question the value of museums now that vast amounts of historical information are available online.

title: unverifiable
meaning_vi: không thể kiểm chứng

examples.en: A great deal of content posted online about historical events is unverifiable and should be treated with caution.

title: analytical thinking and creativity
meaning_vi: tư duy phân tích và sáng tạo

examples.en: Passive television viewing rarely stimulates analytical thinking and creativity in the way that reading does.

title: instilling
meaning_vi: (verb (gerund)). gieo rắc, nuôi dưỡng (giá trị, tinh thần)

examples.en: Protest songs have historically played a role in instilling a sense of unity among people fighting for social justice.

title: lessen one's stress levels
meaning_vi: giảm mức độ căng thẳng

examples.en: Listening to calming music before bed can lessen one's stress levels and improve the quality of sleep.

title: relieve stress and mental exhaustion at work
term: relieve stress and mental exhaustion at work
pronunciation: /rɪˈliːv strɛs ænd ˈmɛntl ɪɡˈzɔːstʃən ət wɜːk/
meaning_vi: giải tỏa căng thẳng và mệt mỏi tinh thần trong công việc

examples.en: Attending live performances at weekends helps many professionals relieve stress and mental exhaustion at work.

title: stress reduction
meaning_vi: sự giảm căng thẳng

examples.en: For many office workers, music offers an accessible form of stress reduction during hectic weekdays.

title: carefully curated
meaning_vi: được tuyển chọn, sắp xếp kỹ lưỡng

examples.en: A carefully curated exhibition can tell a more coherent story than scattered information found through a search engine.

title: government-affiliated website
meaning_vi: trang web trực thuộc chính phủ

examples.en: Unless information comes from a government-affiliated website, its accuracy can be difficult for the public to confirm.

title: a tradition of upholding rigorous editorial standards
term: a tradition of upholding rigorous editorial standards
pronunciation: /ə trəˈdɪʃən əv ʌpˈhəʊldɪŋ ˈrɪɡərəs ˌedɪˈtɔːriəl ˈstændədz/
meaning_vi: truyền thống duy trì các tiêu chuẩn biên tập nghiêm ngặt

examples.en: Newspapers have a tradition of upholding rigorous editorial standards, which lends their reporting greater credibility.

title: an in-depth analysis of current events
term: an in-depth analysis of current events
meaning_vi: một phân tích chuyên sâu về các sự kiện thời sự

examples.en: Documentaries can offer viewers an in-depth analysis of current events that a thirty-second news clip cannot provide.

title: audience engagement
meaning_vi: sự tương tác của khán giả

examples.en: Streaming platforms constantly experiment with new formats to maximise audience engagement.

title: circulation
meaning_vi: sự lưu hành, phát hành

examples.en: Stricter regulations have been proposed to limit the circulation of movies containing excessive violence.

title: contend
meaning_vi: cho rằng, lập luận

examples.en: Some parents contend that the government should impose stricter age ratings on films to protect younger viewers.

title: cultivate widespread optimism
meaning_vi: nuôi dưỡng sự lạc quan rộng rãi

examples.en: Media coverage that highlights human achievement can cultivate widespread optimism during difficult times.

title: escalate aggression
meaning_vi: làm gia tăng sự hung hăng

examples.en: Researchers warn that prolonged exposure to violent content can escalate aggression in susceptible individuals.

title: fatigued by relentless negativity
meaning_vi: mệt mỏi vì sự tiêu cực liên tục

examples.en: Many viewers report feeling fatigued by relentless negativity in daily news broadcasts.

title: flexibility
meaning_vi: sự linh hoạt

examples.en: Watching a concert online offers viewers flexibility, since they can pause the performance or watch it at any time.

title: frequent exposure
meaning_vi: sự tiếp xúc thường xuyên

examples.en: Frequent exposure to violent films has been linked to heightened anxiety in some viewers.

title: interpersonal violence
meaning_vi: bạo lực giữa các cá nhân

examples.en: There is ongoing debate about whether violent entertainment contributes to interpersonal violence in real life.

title: minimal
meaning_vi: tối thiểu

examples.en: Streaming a live show requires only minimal equipment, typically a smartphone and a stable internet connection.

title: normalize aggression
meaning_vi: bình thường hóa hành vi hung hăng

examples.en: Critics contend that violent films normalize aggression by portraying it as an acceptable way to resolve conflict.

title: pirated
meaning_vi: vi phạm bản quyền, lậu

examples.en: Children can easily stumble upon pirated movie websites that host age-inappropriate content without any restrictions.

title: positive narratives
meaning_vi: những câu chuyện tích cực

examples.en: News outlets that emphasise positive narratives can help restore public confidence in the media.

title: psychological stress
meaning_vi: căng thẳng tâm lý

examples.en: Constant exposure to distressing news can heighten psychological stress among viewers.

title: public trust
meaning_vi: niềm tin của công chúng

examples.en: Sensationalised reporting can gradually erode public trust in mainstream media outlets.

title: stress relief
meaning_vi: giải tỏa căng thẳng

examples.en: Many people turn to action films for stress relief after a demanding day at work.

title: sustainability of the media outlets
meaning_vi: tính bền vững của các kênh truyền thông

examples.en: Relying solely on sensational headlines may ultimately threaten the long-term sustainability of the media outlets themselves.

title: tantalizing
meaning_vi: hấp dẫn, quyến rũ, gây tò mò

examples.en: Directors often rely on tantalizing trailers filled with dramatic scenes to draw large audiences into cinemas.

title: to keep up with the fast-paced nature of contemporary news
term: to keep up with the fast-paced nature of contemporary news
pronunciation: /tuː kiːp ʌp wɪð ðə ˈfɑːstpeɪst ˈneɪtʃər əv kənˈtempərəri njuːz/
meaning_vi: theo kịp bản chất nhanh chóng của tin tức đương đại

examples.en: Many professionals rely on mobile news apps to keep up with the fast-paced nature of contemporary news.

title: villain
meaning_vi: nhân vật phản diện

examples.en: Young viewers sometimes struggle to distinguish right from wrong when a villain is portrayed in a sympathetic light.

title: watching through a screen
meaning_vi: việc xem qua màn hình

examples.en: Although watching through a screen is convenient, it inevitably distances viewers from the emotional intensity of a live show.

title: the appeal of viewing performances on television
term: the appeal of viewing performances on television
pronunciation: /ði əˈpiːl əv ˈvjuːɪŋ pəˈfɔːmənsɪz ɒn ˈtelɪvɪʒən/
meaning_vi: sức hấp dẫn của việc xem các buổi biểu diễn trên truyền hình

examples.en: The appeal of viewing performances on television lies in its convenience and affordability compared with attending in person.

title: a gradual desensitization to aggression
meaning_vi: sự chai lì cảm xúc dần dần trước bạo lực

examples.en: Psychologists warn that prolonged exposure to violent media can cause a gradual desensitization to aggression.

title: actual aggressive behaviors
meaning_vi: hành vi hung hăng thực tế

examples.en: Researchers debate whether violent media truly translates into actual aggressive behaviors offline.

title: boost public morale
meaning_vi: nâng cao tinh thần cộng đồng

examples.en: Inspirational stories broadcast during crises can boost public morale significantly.

title: cutting-edge recording technology
meaning_vi: công nghệ ghi hình tiên tiến, hiện đại

examples.en: Broadcasters now rely on cutting-edge recording technology to capture live performances with exceptional clarity and sound quality.

title: diminished empathy
meaning_vi: sự suy giảm lòng đồng cảm

examples.en: Some studies suggest a correlation between heavy media violence consumption and diminished empathy.

title: establish boundaries for violent content
meaning_vi: thiết lập giới hạn đối với nội dung bạo lực

examples.en: Authorities should establish boundaries for violent content to shield impressionable young audiences from harmful influences.

title: filtering savage elements
meaning_vi: lọc bỏ các yếu tố bạo lực, tàn bạo

examples.en: Rather than banning films outright, filtering savage elements through stricter censorship could be a more balanced solution.

title: handsomely
meaning_vi: hậu hĩnh, đáng kể

examples.en: Streaming platforms reward the most popular performers handsomely, sometimes more than traditional record labels ever did.

title: immediacy and a broader range of viewpoints
term: immediacy and a broader range of viewpoints
pronunciation: /ɪˈmiːdiəsi ənd ə ˈbrɔːdə reɪndʒ əv ˈvjuːpɔɪnts/
meaning_vi: tính tức thời và phạm vi quan điểm rộng hơn

examples.en: Online news platforms attract younger audiences by offering immediacy and a broader range of viewpoints than traditional press.

title: impair attention and concentration
meaning_vi: làm suy giảm khả năng chú ý và tập trung

examples.en: Excessive exposure to fast-paced media can impair attention and concentration in young viewers.

title: injustice
meaning_vi: sự bất công

examples.en: Banning violent films entirely would arguably inflict an injustice upon filmmakers who use such scenes for artistic purposes.

title: leave a negative influence on people's psyche
term: leave a negative influence on people's psyche
pronunciation: /liːv ə ˈnɛɡətɪv ˈɪnfluəns ɒn ˈpiːplz ˈsaɪki/
meaning_vi: để lại ảnh hưởng tiêu cực đến tâm lý con người

examples.en: Repeated exposure to graphic violence on screen can leave a negative influence on people's psyche, especially children.

title: offers close-up camera angles
meaning_vi: mang lại các góc quay cận cảnh

examples.en: Watching a concert on television offers close-up camera angles that let viewers see performers' expressions in remarkable detail.

title: provide a more intimate viewing experience
term: provide a more intimate viewing experience
meaning_vi: mang lại trải nghiệm xem gần gũi, riêng tư hơn

examples.en: Streaming platforms provide a more intimate viewing experience, allowing audiences to enjoy performances from the comfort of their homes.

title: provide significant informative value
meaning_vi: mang lại giá trị thông tin đáng kể

examples.en: Well-researched documentaries provide significant informative value to audiences of all ages.

title: societal cooperation
meaning_vi: sự hợp tác trong xã hội

examples.en: Media campaigns that emphasise unity can foster greater societal cooperation during emergencies.

title: strengthen social cohesion
meaning_vi: củng cố sự gắn kết xã hội

examples.en: Uplifting news stories can strengthen social cohesion by reminding communities of their shared values.

title: technical errors
meaning_vi: lỗi kỹ thuật

examples.en: Live broadcasts occasionally suffer from technical errors, which can frustrate viewers hoping for a flawless experience.

title: academic performance
meaning_vi: kết quả học tập

examples.en: Studies suggest that too much screen time can have a negative impact on children's academic performance.

title: age-inappropriate films
meaning_vi: phim không phù hợp với lứa tuổi

examples.en: Without parental supervision, children may gain access to age-inappropriate films that depict graphic violence.

title: antisocial behaviors
meaning_vi: hành vi chống đối xã hội

examples.en: Researchers have found a possible link between exposure to violent films and antisocial behaviors among teenagers.

title: desensitized
meaning_vi: trở nên chai lì, mất cảm xúc trước điều gì đó

examples.en: Prolonged exposure to violent content can leave young audiences desensitized to real-world suffering.

title: detrimental effects
meaning_vi: những tác động tiêu cực, bất lợi

examples.en: Excessive screen time can have detrimental effects on children's physical and social development.

title: disciplinary interventions
meaning_vi: các biện pháp can thiệp kỷ luật

examples.en: Schools have reported an increase in disciplinary interventions linked to aggressive behaviour among students.

title: extracurricular activities
meaning_vi: hoạt động ngoại khóa

examples.en: Schools often encourage students to take part in extracurricular activities to develop skills beyond the classroom.

title: passive viewers
meaning_vi: người xem thụ động

examples.en: Rather than engaging actively with content, children often become passive viewers who absorb information without question.

title: productive and enjoyable free time
meaning_vi: thời gian rảnh vừa hữu ích vừa vui vẻ

examples.en: A balanced approach that combines guidance with freedom can help children enjoy productive and enjoyable free time.

title: social and cognitive skills
meaning_vi: kỹ năng xã hội và nhận thức

examples.en: Well-planned activities are designed to strengthen children's social and cognitive skills from an early age.

title: violent or aggressive behavior
meaning_vi: hành vi bạo lực hoặc hung hăng

examples.en: Children who regularly watch violent or aggressive behavior on screen may come to view it as normal.

title: a judicious combination
meaning_vi: sự kết hợp khôn ngoan, hợp lý

examples.en: A judicious combination of print, television and online sources gives readers the most balanced picture of world events.

title: erosion of positive social attitudes
meaning_vi: sự xói mòn thái độ xã hội tích cực

examples.en: Some sociologists blame violent entertainment for the gradual erosion of positive social attitudes in modern society.

title: extensive news coverage
meaning_vi: sự đưa tin rộng rãi

examples.en: Extensive news coverage of a single tragic event can overwhelm audiences and heighten anxiety.

title: opting for
meaning_vi: lựa chọn

examples.en: An increasing number of consumers are opting for online streaming rather than travelling to a physical venue.

title: real-time updates and multimedia elements
meaning_vi: cập nhật theo thời gian thực và các yếu tố đa phương tiện

examples.en: By combining real-time updates and multimedia elements, digital news sites keep audiences far more engaged than print alone.

title: reliable purveyors of information
meaning_vi: những đơn vị cung cấp thông tin đáng tin cậy

examples.en: Despite the rise of social media, many people still regard established newspapers as reliable purveyors of information.

title: well-researched and balanced reporting
meaning_vi: việc đưa tin được nghiên cứu kỹ lưỡng và cân bằng

examples.en: Consumers who value well-researched and balanced reporting tend to trust print media over sensationalist online outlets.

title: acquire broader knowledge and vocabulary
meaning_vi: tiếp thu kiến thức và vốn từ vựng rộng hơn

examples.en: Children who watch documentaries often acquire broader knowledge and vocabulary than their peers.

title: impressionable
meaning_vi: dễ bị ảnh hưởng, dễ bị tác động

examples.en: Impressionable young viewers are particularly vulnerable to the negative messages conveyed in violent films.

title: parent-organized activities
meaning_vi: các hoạt động do phụ huynh tổ chức

examples.en: Parent-organized activities such as music lessons and sports clubs can give children valuable structure and discipline.

title: shaping children's behavior
meaning_vi: định hình hành vi của trẻ em

examples.en: Television plays a powerful role in shaping children's behavior, both positively and negatively.

title: take responsibility for
meaning_vi: chịu trách nhiệm về

examples.en: Allowing children to take responsibility for their own free time can help them mature into confident decision-makers.

title: alternative sources
meaning_vi: các nguồn thông tin thay thế

examples.en: As trust in traditional media declines, more people are turning to alternative sources for their news.

title: provide a dynamic and interactive way to engage with news
term: provide a dynamic and interactive way to engage with news
pronunciation: /prəˈvaɪd ə daɪˈnæmɪk ənd ˌɪntərˈæktɪv weɪ tuː ɪnˈɡeɪdʒ wɪð njuːz/
meaning_vi: cung cấp một cách tiếp cận tin tức năng động và tương tác

examples.en: Social media platforms provide a dynamic and interactive way to engage with news that appeals strongly to younger generations.

title: the rapid dissemination of information
meaning_vi: sự phổ biến thông tin nhanh chóng

examples.en: The rapid dissemination of information online can be both a blessing and a curse when unverified stories go viral.

title: achieve higher subscriptions and views
meaning_vi: đạt được nhiều lượt đăng ký và xem hơn

examples.en: Some channels resort to sensational headlines simply to achieve higher subscriptions and views.

title: daily routines
meaning_vi: các thói quen, sinh hoạt hằng ngày

examples.en: Music has become embedded in people's daily routines, accompanying activities from commuting to exercising.

title: dynamic and collaborative environment
meaning_vi: môi trường năng động và mang tính hợp tác

examples.en: Group sports create a dynamic and collaborative environment in which children learn teamwork naturally.

title: promoting physical fitness and coordination
meaning_vi: thúc đẩy thể lực và khả năng phối hợp cơ thể

examples.en: Traditional games such as tag are effective at promoting physical fitness and coordination in young children.

title: pursue their interests
meaning_vi: theo đuổi sở thích của mình

examples.en: Governments should fund community centres so that people from all backgrounds can pursue their interests, whether in music, sport or art.

title: pursuing hobbies
meaning_vi: theo đuổi sở thích cá nhân

examples.en: Parents should encourage children to spend more time pursuing hobbies rather than passively watching television.

title: child-led free time
meaning_vi: thời gian rảnh do trẻ tự quyết định

examples.en: Advocates of child-led free time believe it encourages children to explore their own interests without adult interference.

title: develop a sense of independence and self-confidence
term: develop a sense of independence and self-confidence
pronunciation: /dɪˈveləp ə sens əv ˌɪndɪˈpendəns ənd self ˈkɒnfɪdəns/
meaning_vi: phát triển tính độc lập và sự tự tin

examples.en: Unstructured play allows children to develop a sense of independence and self-confidence as they make their own decisions.

title: excessive screen time
meaning_vi: thời gian sử dụng màn hình quá nhiều

examples.en: Excessive screen time in early childhood has been associated with delayed language development.

title: experience a more well-rounded development
meaning_vi: trải nghiệm sự phát triển toàn diện hơn

examples.en: Children who play a mix of outdoor and educational games tend to experience a more well-rounded development.

title: in favor of
meaning_vi: ủng hộ, tán thành

examples.en: Those in favor of parent-organized activities believe children benefit most from adult guidance during their free time.

title: interact with their peers
meaning_vi: tương tác với bạn bè đồng trang lứa

examples.en: Outdoor games give children a chance to interact with their peers in a natural, unstructured setting.

title: overall well-being
meaning_vi: sức khỏe và tinh thần tổng thể

examples.en: A balanced approach to entertainment is essential for children's overall well-being.

title: pro-social behavior
meaning_vi: hành vi vì lợi ích xã hội

examples.en: Television programmes that model kindness can encourage pro-social behavior in young audiences.

title: proponents
meaning_vi: những người ủng hộ

examples.en: Proponents of child-led free time argue that children learn best when allowed to make their own choices.

title: social isolation
meaning_vi: sự cô lập xã hội

examples.en: Excessive gaming can lead to social isolation, as children withdraw from face-to-face interaction.

title: supplementing classroom education
meaning_vi: bổ sung cho việc học ở trường

examples.en: Documentaries can play a valuable role in supplementing classroom education with real-world examples.

title: unconsciously adopt
meaning_vi: vô thức tiếp nhận, bắt chước

examples.en: Young viewers may unconsciously adopt the attitudes and mannerisms displayed by their favourite television characters.

title: a short-lived career
meaning_vi: sự nghiệp ngắn ngủi

examples.en: Many pop idols experience a short-lived career because public taste in the entertainment industry changes so rapidly.

title: achieve international fame
meaning_vi: đạt được danh tiếng quốc tế

examples.en: Athletes who achieve international fame often become household names within a matter of years.

title: amasses substantial wealth
meaning_vi: tích lũy khối tài sản khổng lồ

examples.en: A top-tier celebrity often amasses substantial wealth within a remarkably short span of their career.

title: delves into
meaning_vi: đi sâu tìm hiểu, phân tích kỹ

examples.en: This essay delves into the reasons why celebrities often earn far more than professionals in other essential fields.

title: derive their income
meaning_vi: kiếm thu nhập từ, có được thu nhập từ

examples.en: Many celebrities derive their income from multiple sources rather than relying solely on their original profession.

title: diversification of income streams
meaning_vi: sự đa dạng hóa các nguồn thu nhập

examples.en: The diversification of income streams, from acting to product lines, explains why some celebrities earn extraordinary sums.

title: look up to media and sports celebrities
term: look up to media and sports celebrities
pronunciation: /lʊk ʌp tuː ˈmiːdiə ənd spɔːts sɛlɪˈbrɪtiz/
meaning_vi: ngưỡng mộ và noi theo những người nổi tiếng trong lĩnh vực truyền thông và thể thao

examples.en: Many young people look up to media and sports celebrities, believing that emulating their lifestyles will bring similar success.

title: years of intensive training and dedication
term: years of intensive training and dedication
meaning_vi: nhiều năm khổ luyện và tận tụy

examples.en: Behind every successful performer lie years of intensive training and dedication that the public rarely witnesses.

title: to enjoy entertainment performances at home
term: to enjoy entertainment performances at home
meaning_vi: thưởng thức các buổi biểu diễn giải trí tại nhà

examples.en: Streaming services now allow audiences to enjoy entertainment performances at home without purchasing an expensive ticket.

title: shaping
meaning_vi: (verb (gerund)). định hình, hình thành

examples.en: Popular music plays a significant part in shaping the values and attitudes of younger generations.

title: a primary driver
meaning_vi: một động lực chính, yếu tố then chốt

examples.en: Brand partnerships remain a primary driver of the enormous wealth accumulated by modern celebrities.

title: commodity
meaning_vi: hàng hóa, sản phẩm thương mại

examples.en: In today's streaming era, music has increasingly become a commodity marketed to maximize commercial profit.

title: intersect with the commercial world
meaning_vi: giao thoa với thế giới thương mại

examples.en: As celebrities increasingly intersect with the commercial world, their public image becomes inseparable from marketing strategies.

title: lucrative endorsement deals
meaning_vi: các hợp đồng quảng cáo sinh lời cao

examples.en: Famous athletes frequently sign lucrative endorsement deals with major brands, dramatically boosting their overall earnings.

title: sponsorship agreements
meaning_vi: các thỏa thuận tài trợ

examples.en: Sponsorship agreements with global corporations allow public figures to earn income that far exceeds their base salaries.

title: cultural fabric of societies
meaning_vi: kết cấu văn hóa của các xã hội

examples.en: Traditional music remains deeply woven into the cultural fabric of societies across the globe.

title: cultural identities
meaning_vi: bản sắc văn hóa

examples.en: Traditional festivals and music help preserve the cultural identities of communities in an increasingly globalized world.

title: a distorted understanding of success and social values
term: a distorted understanding of success and social values
pronunciation: /ə dɪˈstɔːtɪd ˌʌndəˈstændɪŋ əv səkˈsɛs ənd ˈsəʊʃəl ˈvæljuːz/
meaning_vi: nhận thức lệch lạc về thành công và giá trị xã hội

examples.en: Constant exposure to glamorous celebrity lifestyles may give children a distorted understanding of success and social values.

title: an excessive focus on fame and wealth
term: an excessive focus on fame and wealth
pronunciation: /ən ɪkˈsɛsɪv ˈfəʊkəs ɒn feɪm ənd wɛlθ/
meaning_vi: sự tập trung thái quá vào danh tiếng và tiền bạc

examples.en: An excessive focus on fame and wealth in popular media can distort young people's priorities in life.

title: as acceptable or even trendy
meaning_vi: được xem là chấp nhận được hoặc thậm chí thời thượng

examples.en: Repeated media exposure can make reckless behaviour seem as acceptable or even trendy among young audiences.

title: develop a strong work ethic
meaning_vi: rèn luyện tinh thần làm việc nghiêm túc

examples.en: Watching disciplined athletes can inspire young fans to develop a strong work ethic in their own lives.

title: impressionable teenagers
meaning_vi: thanh thiếu niên dễ bị tác động

examples.en: Impressionable teenagers are particularly susceptible to the lifestyles portrayed by their favourite celebrities.

title: pose serious challenges
meaning_vi: gây ra những thách thức nghiêm trọng

examples.en: Excessive admiration for celebrity wealth can pose serious challenges to how young people define success.

title: prioritize materialistic values
meaning_vi: coi trọng các giá trị vật chất

examples.en: Constant exposure to celebrity lifestyles may cause young viewers to prioritize materialistic values over personal growth.

title: the disproportionate gap
meaning_vi: khoảng cách không cân xứng

examples.en: The disproportionate gap between celebrity earnings and average wages can distort young people's career aspirations.

title: the imitation of harmful behaviors
meaning_vi: sự bắt chước những hành vi có hại

examples.en: Critics argue that the imitation of harmful behaviors seen on screen can negatively influence impressionable viewers.

title: the income disparity
meaning_vi: sự chênh lệch thu nhập

examples.en: The income disparity between famous celebrities and ordinary workers has sparked considerable public debate in recent years.

title: the lopsided income distribution
meaning_vi: sự phân phối thu nhập mất cân đối

examples.en: The lopsided income distribution between celebrities and other professionals raises important questions about societal values.

title: desensitize viewers
meaning_vi: làm khán giả chai lì cảm xúc

examples.en: Repeated depictions of graphic violence may desensitize viewers to real-world suffering.

title: societal impact
meaning_vi: tác động đến xã hội

examples.en: Beyond personal enjoyment, music can have a lasting societal impact by shaping public opinion on important issues.

title: materialism
meaning_vi: chủ nghĩa vật chất

examples.en: Constant exposure to advertising can foster materialism among children from a very young age.

title: intellectual growth
meaning_vi: sự phát triển trí tuệ

examples.en: Thoughtfully designed educational content can foster intellectual growth rather than hinder it.

title: slow overall mental development
meaning_vi: làm chậm sự phát triển trí tuệ tổng thể

examples.en: Some experts believe that unrestricted screen exposure may slow overall mental development in young children.

title: act as positive role models
meaning_vi: đóng vai trò là tấm gương tích cực

examples.en: Some celebrities act as positive role models by using their platform to promote charitable causes.

title: maintaining positive images
meaning_vi: duy trì hình ảnh tích cực

examples.en: Celebrities face constant pressure to succeed in maintaining positive images in front of the public and the media.

title: participate in beneficial activities
meaning_vi: tham gia vào các hoạt động có ích

examples.en: Inspired by their idols, many teenagers begin to participate in beneficial activities such as sports or volunteer work.

title: set good examples
meaning_vi: làm gương tốt

examples.en: As role models, celebrities have a responsibility to set good examples for their young fans to follow.

title: preserving traditional values
meaning_vi: gìn giữ các giá trị truyền thống

examples.en: Folk musicians contribute significantly to preserving traditional values that might otherwise be lost to modernisation.

title: pursue traditional music
meaning_vi: theo đuổi dòng nhạc truyền thống

examples.en: Young artists who pursue traditional music play a vital role in keeping their country's cultural heritage alive.

title: social change
meaning_vi: sự thay đổi xã hội

examples.en: Throughout history, music has been used as a powerful tool to inspire social change and challenge injustice.

title: foster creativity and critical thinking skills
term: foster creativity and critical thinking skills
meaning_vi: nuôi dưỡng khả năng sáng tạo và tư duy phản biện

examples.en: Free, unsupervised play can foster creativity and critical thinking skills that structured lessons rarely provide.

title: valuable traits
meaning_vi: những phẩm chất quý giá

examples.en: Organized activities can help children develop valuable traits such as patience, teamwork, and perseverance.
